name: BACH_0140
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn

The conformal set, the second model and all 5 similar cases agree on Benign. Invasive probability rounds to 0%.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%; others <1% | Very peaked |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Benign | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 2, 6, 8) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 4, 6, 8) · context · Higher than 93% of reference images [F8] · Measured
- **Nuclear shape variation** (regions 4, 6, 8) · context · Higher than 90% of reference images [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. TILs spot check is 8/20 (Weak).

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration rests on a small test set (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18); 100% may overstate certainty.
- Cell measures cover only regions 4, 6, 8; unsampled regions could differ.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 6, 8:** confirm the nuclear shape variation and immune cell density.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 11:** verify glands look benign, not infiltrative.
3. **Regions 5, 6:** inspect stroma for infiltration (5) and pleomorphism (6).
